claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SQ-22536 is a weak, non-competitive adenylyl cyclase inhibitor (IC50 ~13 uM in platelets) that at 2.5 uM is far below concentrations needed for meaningful cAMP-pathway inhibition, so it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
